findings.title: Intraday monitor rejects the artifact the morning stage deliberately publishes, killing the monitoring loop on every cycle
findings.claim_tested: The 5-minute intraday monitoring loop runs and observes saved picks during the trading session.
evidence: Live DB daily_run_stages: intraday_monitor FAILED x344, morning_collection FAILED x5, ranking_delivery FAILED x5, eod_outcome_capture FAILED x4, paper_reconciliation FAILED x4, paperops_forward FAILED x4, alpha_learning FAILED x4.
monitor_interval_gaps: 79 MISSED_INTERVAL per day for 2026-08-31..2026-09-03 and 35 on 2026-09-04; zero observed intervals.
No alpha_monitor-*.stdout.log or trade_watch-*.stdout.log exists in C:/r/dawnstrike-state/logs; only calendar/heartbeat wrappers. The monitoring CLI has never executed.

Reproduced directly: dot-sourcing C:/r/dawnstrike-runtime/scripts/alpha_cycle_artifact.ps1 and calling Test-DawnstrikeAlphaCycleArtifact on the real 2026-09-03 artifact throws: AlphaOps cycle artifact core universe is not READY; full core coverage is unavailable.
Artifact run_contract.core_universe_status = DATA_UNAVAILABLE; S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 verdicts both observed_unique_count 0 with blockers expected_count_missing/membership_absent.
findings.observed: run_alphaops_monitor.ps1:355-358 calls Test-DawnstrikeAlphaCycleArtifact with neither -AllowCoreShortfall nor -RequireCoreCoverage. In alpha_cycle_artifact.ps1 the coreCoverageRequired expression evaluates true when core_universe_status is DATA_UNAVAILABLE and -AllowCoreShortfall is absent, so the validator throws and the monitor sets error_code alpha_cycle_artifact_invalid and exits 2 on every cycle.
findings.expected: The monitor should tolerate a governed lane-local core-universe shortfall exactly as the morning stage does, because the monitor consumes only research_candidate_count and research_symbols from the artifact and does not use core-universe membership at all.
findings.impact: The entire post-morning product loop is dead: no intraday monitoring, no trade-watch, no entries, no outcome capture, no paper reconciliation, no learning. This is the difference between a working decision-support product and a daily premarket email.
findings.root_cause: Inconsistent core-coverage strictness between two callers of one shared validator. run_alphaops_morning.ps1:229-236 passes -AllowCoreShortfall with an explicit comment that a core refresh outage is lane-local and the mover lane remains publishable; the monitor omits it.
findings.remediation: Pass -AllowCoreShortfall at the monitor call site so the two stages share one contract, and add a regression test asserting the monitor invocation tolerates a lane-local core shortfall.
findings.acceptance_test: A test proving the monitor accepts an artifact whose run_contract.core_universe_status is DATA_UNAVAILABLE, plus a live cycle producing an alpha_monitor-<date>.stdout.log and an observed (not MISSED) monitor interval.

findings.title: Existing test proves the validator shortfall behavior but nothing asserts the monitor passes the flag
findings.claim_tested: The 5,150-test suite would catch a break in the core daily loop.
evidence: tests/test_alpha_cycle_artifact_ps1.py:261-273 test_artifact_accepts_lane_local_core_data_unavailable_shortfall asserts strict mode REJECTS core_universe_status=DATA_UNAVAILABLE (core universe is not READY in stderr) and that -AllowCoreShortfall accepts it.
grep of tests/ for AllowCoreShortfall matches only that one file; no test exercises the run_alphaops_monitor.ps1 invocation.
findings.observed: The unit contract is tested in both directions while the production caller that violates it is untested, so a 100%-failure production defect coexists with a passing targeted suite.
findings.expected: A caller-level or source-contract test should assert the monitor tolerates a lane-local core shortfall.
findings.impact: Test count is not evidence of working user journeys. This is the concrete instance proving that.
findings.root_cause: Coverage stops at the shared helper; PowerShell stage scripts are only partially contract-tested.
findings.remediation: Add a monitor-invocation contract test alongside the existing validator test.
findings.acceptance_test: New test fails before the DS-P0-001 fix and passes after.

findings.title: Registered scheduled task is incompatible with the monitor script at origin/main
findings.claim_tested: The current head can be deployed to the existing runtime without changing task registration.
evidence: Live task Dawnstrike AlphaOps Monitor 5m arguments: -File C:/r/dawnstrike-runtime/scripts/run_alphaops_monitor.ps1 -RuntimeRoot ... -StateRoot ... only.
C:/r/dawnstrike-runtime (b7220890) monitor param block: RuntimeRoot, StateRoot, MarketDate, Notify - all optional.
origin/main (14ca714f) monitor param block adds three Mandatory params: ExpectedSha, LaunchManifestPath, LaunchManifestSha256.
findings.observed: Upgrading the runtime to origin/main without re-registering the task would leave three mandatory parameters unsupplied in a non-interactive scheduled context.
findings.expected: Deployment procedure and task registration move together, or the parameters degrade safely.
findings.impact: A routine runtime upgrade would silently break the scheduled pipeline.
findings.root_cause: Task registration scripts and stage-script signatures evolved on separate cadences; the runtime is pinned three days behind origin/main.
findings.remediation: Re-register tasks as part of the documented runtime upgrade, and add a preflight that validates every registered task argument set against the target commit parameter signatures.
findings.acceptance_test: A preflight check that fails when a registered task omits a mandatory parameter of the target commit stage script.

findings.title: The only Streamlit dashboard render test is broken by a Streamlit API change; the dashboard itself is fine
findings.claim_tested: The primary Streamlit dashboard has working automated verification.
evidence: py -m pytest tests/test_streamlit_app.py at origin/main fails: FileNotFoundError: AppTest script not found at C:/r/dawnstrike-cert-20260904/tests/app.py. Relative paths are resolved against the file that calls AppTest.from_file().
Same failure reproduced independently in the primary checkout.

Driving AppTest with an absolute path succeeds: exception=ElementList(), error=ElementList(), tabs=[Today, Picks, Calendar, Performance, System], DB not created, warnings include SQLite database not found ... empty, read-only state and Evidence is insufficient until at least 20 real market days are audited.
findings.observed: The app renders correctly; only the test relative-path assumption is stale under streamlit 1.63.0.
findings.expected: The UI smoke test should pass and guard the dashboard.
findings.impact: The primary user interface currently has no passing automated regression guard, so UI breakage would go undetected. Severity is limited because the product itself is verified working.
findings.root_cause: AppTest.from_file resolves relative paths against the calling file; pyproject pins only streamlit>=1.32 so the behavior change was admitted silently.
findings.remediation: Resolve app.py from the repository root in the test (absolute path), and pin a tested streamlit upper bound or add a compatibility note.

findings.title: config_hash attached to every ranked candidate incorporates local filesystem paths
findings.claim_tested: config_hash is a stable fingerprint of scoring configuration usable to compare runs.
evidence: Two scans of sample_data/premarket_snapshot_sample.csv differing only in --out-dir and --db-path produced identical values in every ranked_candidates.csv column except config_hash (e464382b3509 vs b35f68c75312).
Changing only --out-dir also changed it (e464382b3509 vs 2e59adc5acdf).
Two runs with identical --out-dir and --db-path produced the identical hash twice (1885ac5b81d9).
scoring.py:407-409 hashes config.public_dict(), which includes database_path and output_dir.
findings.observed: config_hash is deterministic given identical paths but changes when only output/database paths change, so it cannot be compared across machines or output directories.
findings.expected: A configuration fingerprint should cover scoring/strategy parameters, not local I/O locations.
findings.impact: Weakens cross-run and cross-machine reproducibility comparison and provenance auditing. It does not affect any score, rank, or level.
findings.root_cause: public_dict() conflates runtime I/O settings with strategy configuration.
findings.remediation: Hash only the strategy/scoring-relevant subset, or emit a separate strategy_config_hash alongside the existing value.
findings.acceptance_test: Two scans differing only in --out-dir/--db-path produce an identical strategy configuration hash.

findings.title: Zero trades in 25 forward paper-trading days: no demonstrated edge exists
findings.claim_tested: Dawnstrike has produced credible evidence that its insights outperform alternatives after realistic costs.
evidence: paper_account_daily_ledger, official_forward_paper cohort, 2026-07-31..2026-09-03 = 25 trading days: 21 rows status MISSING/evidence_state missing, 4 rows status NO_TRADE. trade_count 0 on every row. target_return_pct 1.0 with target_status PENDING on every row.

All of signal_outcomes, paper_positions, paper_trade_fills, paper_audit_trades, manual_outcomes, alpha_outcome_labels, alpha_v6_outcomes, strategy_learning_labels, alpha_learning_runs, trade_intents, committed_fill_truth_receipts, outcome_capture_attempts contain 0 rows.
105 of 145 tables in the live database are empty; schema_version 30 initialized 2026-08-30.
findings.observed: The forward paper record contains no completed trade of any kind. The learning loop has never closed once in this database.
findings.expected: For any edge claim, a statistically meaningful sample of completed, cost-adjusted outcomes.
findings.impact: Verdict C (Demonstrated Product Edge) is determinable without statistical analysis: there is nothing to analyze. No performance claim of any kind is currently supportable.
findings.root_cause: Downstream starvation from DS-P0-001 plus a strategy that has selected no qualifying entry on any observed day.
findings.remediation: Fix DS-P0-001 first; edge evaluation cannot begin until the loop closes and completed outcomes accumulate.
findings.acceptance_test: A non-zero count of completed, cost-adjusted paper outcomes across a pre-registered sample of trading days.

findings.title: Truth discipline is real and verified in production, not aspirational
findings.claim_tested: Dawnstrike refuses to fabricate or overstate evidence.
evidence: Unobserved monitor slots are persisted as explicit MISSED_INTERVAL receipts carrying missing_is_not_zero: true rather than being dropped or zero-filled.
No-trade days record return_basis explicit_no_trade_observed_zero and observed_zero true, distinct from MISSING/pending days which keep net_return_pct NULL.

Daily finalize for 2026-09-03 returned status DEGRADED, upstream_status failed, deployment_url null, next_action missing_or_degraded_upstream_truth_or_safety - it refused to publish to the public dashboard while upstream was degraded.
Stage failures were delivered to Telegram on 2026-08-31, 09-01, 09-02 and 09-03 (stage_failure_notification receipts, sent: true).
Streamlit dashboard on an empty database warns Evidence is insufficient until at least 20 real market days are audited and does not create the database.
Every receipt carries research_only: true and broker_execution_enabled: false.
findings.observed: The system consistently distinguishes missing from zero, refuses to publish degraded truth, and labels insufficient evidence as insufficient.
findings.expected: n/a - this is a verified strength to protect.
findings.impact: This is the most defensible property of the product and a principal reason the codebase is salvageable. It must not be weakened by any remediation.
findings.remediation: Protect it. Any fix to DS-P0-001 must preserve the fail-visible contract rather than loosening validation generally.
findings.acceptance_test: Regression tests asserting missing != zero and refuse-to-publish-degraded remain green after remediation.
